Cache per-event spatial edge-correction marks

Source: R/trigger_reestimate.R
trigger_spatial_marks.Rd

For each event i, shifts the triggering kernel's spatial grid (spatial_trigger$x/spatial_trigger$y) by that event's coordinates and flags which shifted grid cells fall inside the study region, caching the result to disk (one .rds file per event). trigger_edge_correction() reads these back to compute each event's spatial edge-correction factor and the pooled spatial "repetance" surface.

Usage

trigger_spatial_marks(
  events,
  spatial_trigger,
  cache_dir,
  force = FALSE,
  nprocs = 1
)

Arguments

events

A semihawkes_events object (from prepare_events()).

spatial_trigger

A semihawkes_trigger_spatial object (from trigger_spatial_init() or trigger_reestimate_spatial()) – its x/y grid defines the marks that get cached.

cache_dir

Directory to write/read .rds mark files; created if it doesn't exist. Required, no default.

force

If TRUE, recompute and overwrite marks that are already cached; default FALSE (skip events with an existing file, matching the original script's if (!file.exists(fn)) guard).

nprocs

Parallel workers, as for trigger_evaluate(): a whole number (the default, 1, runs serially), "auto", or a cluster from parallel::makeCluster(), which is used and left running.

Value

cache_dir, invisibly.

Details

A grid cell counts as inside if it intersects the region, as sf::st_intersects() decides, so cells on the boundary count as inside. To keep this fast for many events, the shifted grids of up to 200 events are tested at once, mostly with spatstat's point-in-polygon test; cells within a hair's breadth of the boundary (a thousandth of the grid step) are tested with sf::st_intersects() itself, so the marks are the same as testing every cell with sf.

Examples

ev <- prepare_events(sim_events, sim_region, date_col = "date",
                     end_date = "2022-01-01")
#> The modelled study period ends on 2021-12-29, the day after the last event. `end_date` (2022-01-01) is used only to select events and to label outputs.
ev <- add_adaptive_bandwidth(ev, k = 5, min_dist = 150, min_bandwidth = 300)
ev <- add_bg_integral(ev, n_mc = 500, seed = 1)
ts <- trigger_spatial_init(x_range = 2000, x_step = 250)
cache_dir <- tempfile("spHawkes_marks_")
trigger_spatial_marks(ev, ts, cache_dir = cache_dir)
length(list.files(cache_dir))  # one file per event
#> [1] 98
